summary: Incentivi module iteration: tested backend modalita reale/provvisoria, 50/50 energia split (acquisizione/lavorazione), same-person single row, previste ref_ids/descrizione, config migrations (fattore 1.0, riparazioni_a=Bruno, gettone energia 10, energia 25/50%), foglio rows mese = mese_fattura+1, riparazioni attributed to Bruno, /mio provvisoria for open month. 11/11 pytest passed against public URL (admin login via TOTP). Frontend also verified (login with TOTP works): modalita toggle changes text and fires calcolo?modalita=provvisoria (200), Regole select inc-riparazioni-a-select shows Bruno, In pagamento button inc-foglio-anteprima reads 'Carica fatturato EOLO del mese prima → pagato 2026-11'. All TEST- data removed (verified 0 residual docs).

minor.issue: In provvisoria mode the current month fondo (from gestionale) is compared against historic months computed in REALE mode: mixed bases, bonus 'superato' could be misleading in the provisional classifica shown to the team.

If acquirer is empty/unknown and a lavoratore exists, split still happens (12.5 to unidentified + 12.5 to lavoratore) instead of 25 to the lavoratore; unidentified row may then fall back to persona_negozio (e.g. Kevin for Gravedona). Confirm intended.

issues: GETTONI card subtitle says '25 € lordi a contratto' only (EOLO); energia gettone is 10 € (5 per half) - could add energia value to avoid confusion
